arxiv-2208-08009.title: Resource Allocation in Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) for Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks
arxiv-2208-08009.creator: Rakpong Kaewpuang 1 , Minrui Xu 1 , Dusit Niyato 1 , Han Yu 1 , and Zehui Xiong 2
arxiv-2208-08009.description: Abstract Space-air-ground integrated networks (SAGIN) are one of the most promising advanced paradigms in the sixth generation (6G) communication. SAGIN can support high data rates, low latency, and seamless network coverage for interconnected applications and services. However, communications in SAGIN are facing tremendous security threats from the ever-increasing capacity of quantum computers.

arxiv-2212-07445.title: Superconductivity in monolayer and few-layer graphene: III Impurity-induced subgap states and quasi-particle interference patterns
arxiv-2212-07445.creator: Emile Pangburn, Louis Haurie, Adeline Crépieux, Oladunjoye A. Awoga, Nicholas Sedlmayr, Annica M. Black-Schaffer, Catherine Pépin, Cristina Bena
arxiv-2212-07445.description: Abstract We consider the most energetically favorable symmetry-allowed spin-singlet and spin-triplet superconducting pairing symmetries in monolayer and few-layer graphene, and for each calculate the energy spectrum in the presence of a scalar or magnetic impurity. We find that two doubly degenerate subgap states exist for scalar impurities for all types of pairing, except for the spin-singlet s s -wave state.

arxiv-2303-12606.creator: Ahmed Bouajjani, Constantin Enea, Enrique Román-Calvo
arxiv-2303-12606.description: Abstract . Modern applications, such as social networking systems and e-commerce platforms are centered around using large-scale databases for storing and retrieving data. Accesses to the database are typically enclosed in transactions that allow computations on shared data to be isolated from other concurrent computations and resilient to failures. Modern databases trade isolation for performance.

arxiv-2307-07907.title: Seeing is not Believing: Robust Reinforcement Learning against Spurious Correlation
arxiv-2307-07907.creator: Wenhao Ding, Laixi Shi, Yuejie Chi, Ding Zhao
arxiv-2307-07907.description: Abstract Robustness has been extensively studied in reinforcement learning (RL) to handle various forms of uncertainty such as random perturbations, rare events, and malicious attacks. In this work, we consider one critical type of robustness against spurious correlation, where different portions of the state do not have correlations induced by unobserved confounders.

arxiv-2309-06807.title: Bayesian uncertainty-weighted loss for improved generalisability on polyp segmentation task
arxiv-2309-06807.creator: Rebecca S. Stone(✉), Pedro E. Chavarrias-Solano, Andrew J. Bulpitt, David C. Hogg, Sharib Ali(✉)
arxiv-2309-06807.description: Abstract While several previous studies have devised methods for segmentation of polyps, most of these methods are not rigorously assessed on multi-center datasets. Variability due to appearance of polyps from one center to another, difference in endoscopic instrument grades, and acquisition quality result in methods with good performance on in-distribution test data, and poor performance on out-of-distribution or underrepresented samples.

arxiv-2403-09476.title: Sunyaev-Zeldovich Signals from L ∗ L^{*} Galaxies: Observations, Analytics, and Simulations
arxiv-2403-09476.creator: Yossi Oren, Amiel Sternberg, Christopher F. McKee, Yakov Faerman, Shy Genel
arxiv-2403-09476.description: Abstract We analyze measurements of the thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich (tSZ) effect arising in the circumgalactic medium (CGM) of L ∗ L^{*} galaxies, reported by Bregman et al. 2022 and Das et al. 2023 . In our analysis we use the Faerman et al. 2017 ; Faerman et al. 2020 CGM models, a new power-law model (PLM), and the TNG100 simulation.

arxiv-2412-20835.title: A Constructive Approach to Complete Spaces
arxiv-2412-20835.creator: Valery Isaev
arxiv-2412-20835.description: Abstract . In this paper, we present a constructive generalization of metric and uniform spaces by introducing a new class of spaces, called cover spaces. These spaces form a topological concrete category with a full reflective subcategory of complete spaces. This subcategory is closely related to a particular subcategory of locales, offering an alternative approach to localic completion.

arxiv-2503-04687.title: Compositional World Knowledge leads to High Utility Synthetic data
arxiv-2503-04687.creator: Sachit Gaudi, Gautam Sreekumar, Vishnu Naresh Boddeti
arxiv-2503-04687.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sachit Gaudi, Gautam Sreekumar, Vishnu Naresh Boddeti. Machine learning systems struggle with robustness, under subpopulation shifts. This problem becomes especially pronounced in scenarios where only a subset of attribute combinations is observed during training—a severe form of subpopulation shift, referred as compositional shift . To address this problem, we ask the following question: Can we improve the robustness by training on synthetic data, spanning all possible attribute combinations?

arxiv-2509-01765.title: Non-conflicting Energy Minimization in Reinforcement Learning based Robot Control
arxiv-2509-01765.creator: Skand Peri Akhil Perincherry Bikram Pandit Stefan Lee
arxiv-2509-01765.description: Abstract Efficient robot control often requires balancing task performance with energy expenditure. A common approach in reinforcement learning (RL) is to penalize energy use directly as part of the reward function. This requires carefully tuning weight terms to avoid undesirable trade-offs where energy minimization harms task success.

arxiv-2510-24436.title: Payne’s nodal line conjecture fails on doubly-connected planar domains
arxiv-2510-24436.creator: Pedro Freitas, Roméo Leylekian
arxiv-2510-24436.description: Abstract . We present examples of bounded planar domains with one single hole for which the nodal line of a second Dirichlet eigenfunction is closed and does not touch the boundary. This shows that Payne’s nodal line conjecture can at most hold for simply-connected domains in the plane. 1.

pmc-12439711.title: Association of Decay Accelerating Factor (CD55) Positive Extracellular Vesicles with Advanced Age and Blood Glucose Levels in Elderly Individuals
pmc-12439711.creator: Xinyang Yue, Shuang Liang, Haiyue Zhang, Tenglong Dai, Jun Wu
pmc-12439711.description: BackgroundExtracellular vesicles (EVs) play a pivotal role in driving aging, serving as vehicles for the transmission of aging-related signals. Decay-accelerating factors (DAFs), also known as CD55, a crucial complement regulator, exhibits age-associated alterations, yet its expression on circulating EVs remains poorly characterized.

pmc-12464274.title: Characterization of the effects of oxymatrine on myocardial hypertrophy in spontaneously hypertensive rats through transcriptomics and metabolomics
pmc-12464274.creator: Chaohong Li, Xingyu Li, Jie Tan, Qinghua Fang, Muzi Zhang, Jing Huang
pmc-12464274.description: Cardiac hypertrophy is a cardiac structural remodeling and dysfunction resulting from chronic hypertension and is an independent risk factor for cardiovascular morbidity and mortality. Oxymatrine (OMT), an alkaloid extracted from the traditional Chinese medicine Sophora flavescens, can ameliorate cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure. However, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

pmc-13240091.title: Effects of the Intensity, Duration, and Muscle Mass of Isometric Handgrip Exercise on Neuromuscular Fatigue and Post‐Exercise Blood Pressure Responses: A Crossover Study
pmc-13240091.creator: Jiawei Wang, Changsi Zhang, Jiaqi Guo, Mansoureh Samadi, Yih‐Kuen Jan
pmc-13240091.description: BackgroundIsometric handgrip exercise (IHE) has emerged as a promising nonpharmacological intervention for blood pressure management. The objective of this study was to investigate the influence of the intensity, duration, and muscle mass factors of IHE protocol variation on the relationship between neuromuscular fatigue and blood pressure changes (systolic blood pressure (SBP), diastolic blood pressure (DBP), and heart rate (HR)).

pmc-13602776.creator: Jiali Jiang, Tangxiaoman Wang, Qiuya Deng, Yurong Zhang
pmc-13602776.description: ObjectiveTo compare perioperative outcomes, complications, and quality of life between tension-free vaginal tape obturator (TVT-O) and retropubic tension-free vaginal tape exact (TVT-E) procedures for female severe stress urinary incontinence (SUI).MethodsThis prospective cohort study enrolled women undergoing surgery for severe stress urinary incontinence (December 2023-February 2025). Patients were grouped by procedure (TVT-O vs. TVT-E).

uslaw-usc-t30-s623.title: 30 U.S.C. § 623 — Recording and reporting of unpatented claims; time
uslaw-usc-t30-s623.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s623.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 16 (Mineral Development Of Lands Withdrawn For Power Development). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The owner of any unpatented mining claim located on land described in section 621 of this title shall file for record in the United States district land office of the land district in which the claim is situated.
